description: Check a video and show it, waiting for news while it is being made. state is waiting (upload link in the answer), uploading, editing, ready, draft (a rough cut, not the finished edit; next_step says how to finish it), cancelled, or failed (problem says why). A download link: with_download: true.

import_id.description: The import_id edit_video gave while the upload is still on its way.

job_id.description: The job_id revise_video returned: also reports that change.

output_id.description: One output to show (a hook, a Short or a shape); the main video when left out.

video_id.description: The video to check (from edit_video, create_video or list_videos).

wait.description: The video card sends false. Leave it out: waiting keeps a check from being wasted.

with_download.description: true: also make a 15-minute download link (only when the user wants the file).

name: check_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint check_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Check a video
